title: Official languages: Africa
intro: Pick an official language of each country in Africa.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Liberia?
questions.explain: English is an official language of Liberia.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Guinea-Bissau?
questions.explain: Portuguese is an official language of Guinea-Bissau.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Comoros?
questions.explain: Ngazidja Comorian is an official language of Comoros.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Congo?
questions.explain: French is an official language of Congo.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Mozambique?
questions.explain: Portuguese is an official language of Mozambique.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Eritrea?
questions.explain: English is an official language of Eritrea.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Sao Tome and Principe?
questions.explain: Portuguese is an official language of Sao Tome and Principe.

questions.prompt: Which of these is an official language of Egypt?
questions.explain: Arabic is an official language of Egypt.
